question: How many existing supplementary criteria can the received notes preserve verbatim under the same 90-word limit?
routes: Same six distinct writer inputs and their frozen path aliases.
assembly: Deduplicate exactly matching text from the same desk. Choose at most one prefix per note, ending at a sentence boundary. Keep original note order, exact note text and the original desk heading. Count headings against the word budget. The established public anchor is outside this budget.
comparators: Blind round-robin filling, exhaustive reviewed-prefix optimum, and exhaustive optimum when the whole notes fit. Include thresholds at 90, 100, 110 and 120 words. Use the 90-word result as primary.
objective: Rank extractive alternatives by guarded five-criterion score, then material score, then shorter length. Keep material-only optima separately for audit. Use the packet weights and the existing strict live rubric.
limits: Same-assistant atom annotations on the received notes define an oracle for this constrained extractive renderer. It cannot infer missing relations, paraphrase or add source information. Its result does not bound other writing interfaces.
